name: Cursed Castle DX
storyline:
In the dark heart of the Cursed Castle, Sir Alaric, an unusual archer who despises the sword, strides forward with his bow held high, his arrows buzzing like echoes of hope in the gloom. Beside him is the eccentric Voktor, a mocking specter who turns fear into macabre laughter, and Osvald, a skeletal archer whose bones rattle with every step, marching like defiant shadows in a realm of darkness.

Closing ranks is the Executioner, a grim figure wielding his axe with ruthless strength, his heavy steps resonating like the echo of a sentence.

Together, this strange quartet faces deadly challenges and ancient creatures as dark magic trembles before them. Each battle unleashes a torrent of fury, and deep within, ultimate evil waits, knowing that these unexpected champions, with their courage and relentless bows, will not rest until they shoot their final arrow into the very heart of darkness.
